verdict.rationale: Probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths on docs.name.com all returned 404, and no document in the pack mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The llms.txt index and per-endpoint markdown reference pages are machine-readable documentation, not a formal API spec. The typed SDKs and MCP server are separate capabilities and do not count here. Confidence is medium rather than high because the probe only covered standard paths, so a spec at another location cannot be ruled out.
